title: resolve: fix effective visibilities for items in ambiguous glob sets

target.summary: `update_decl_chain` recursively traverses `decl.ambiguity_vis_max` without tracking visited declarations or detecting cycles. When mutual glob imports form a cycle in their ambiguous glob sets, this causes infinite recursion and a compiler stack overflow.
notes: unbounded recursive traversal of `ambiguity_vis_max` without cycle detection
definition of `update_decl_chain` whose behavior is faulty due to lack of cycle detection
